answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sparrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The ocean lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the dune is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
